claims.title: The lattice of a local marking and the positive scale for its form
claims.hypotheses: Fix a prime p and the linked period and unitary data with one distinguished embedding (a=1). At multiplicity m=1 the prescribed order is the image of the CM integers acting by scalars. Fix a rational polarised form with symmetric parameter β and a representative b=(c,A) in level-one local coordinates.
claims.statement: Writing P=AΛ and P∨ for the trace dual, the rational lattice is the inverse image of P × cP∨ under the two split CM readings. It is a full order-stable ℤ₍ₚ₎-lattice, self-dual for sBβ whenever s is positive rational and sc is a p-adic unit. One such s is p^(−vₚ(c)).

claims.title: The right stabilizer of a local lattice and the action of rational similitudes
claims.hypotheses: In the same local frame, consider two representatives b=(c,A) and b′=(c′,A′). A rational similitude y acts through a tuple H on the chosen blocks and has multiplier t.
claims.statement: The two rational lattices coincide precisely when b⁻¹b′ belongs to the prescribed integral subgroup Kₚ. The local representative of yM_b is (tc,HA).

claims.title: Realization of a p-local self-dual lattice by a unique right coset
claims.hypotheses: Keep the linked datum and frame. Let M be a full order-stable ℤ₍ₚ₎-lattice perfect for sBβ with s>0 rational.
claims.statement: The first blocks of rational generators determine local basis matrices A, and the choice c=s⁻¹ gives M⊂M_b. Both lattices are self-dual for sBβ, so they agree. The representing right coset bKₚ is unique.
